title: Transaction Log Backup
description: Learn how to back up and restore transaction logs for point-in-time recovery.

data.text: Transaction log backups capture all transactions since the last log backup. They are essential for point-in-time recovery and are only possible when the database is in FULL or BULK_LOGGED recovery model.

data.title: Create a transaction log backup
data.content: Backs up the transaction log of the HR database.

data.title: Restore full backup then transaction log
data.content: Restores full backup and then transaction log backup.

data.title: Transaction Log Backup Key Points
points: Transaction log backups require FULL or BULK_LOGGED recovery model.
Use BACKUP LOG to create transaction log backups.
Use RESTORE LOG to recover from transaction log backups.
Transaction log backups enable point-in-time recovery.
